coding.rationale: When crying is detected (with temperature conditions), adjusting temperature and starting the mobile tune aims to soothe the baby back to calm.
Bowl level sensor detects low food and refills at user-selected times, ensuring the pet is consistently fed.
Pressure detection of an elderly user sitting on the stairlift triggers its activation for safe up/down stairs mobility.
Low water intake combined with long activity triggers dehydration-risk reminders to maintain adequate hydration.
Step count below 10,000 triggers a reminder with the missing count to drive completion of the daily activity goal.
